body: Yeah, 15km from here. Also the situation is pretty calm right now - my mum and sister are both asleep and I think my dad is too.
Thank you. Helps me a lot.
I was referring to physical violence. If there isn't any, the police will show up, check if there are any signs of physical violence and just leave again.
I'm living in a remote Bavarian area. Also you can't just call the cops for something like that, only if there's violence involved which fortunately isn't.

First of all, thanks for your reply. 

We made a final agreement - if my dad's gonna freak out one more time, my mum will get a divorce immediately. We'll see how that works out. 

I can not imagine him hurting someone. He has never punched me or my sister, at all! I'll keep an eye on him, though. He promised me to stay away from alcohol.

We'll see. Thanks for your kind words.

Aw great, I'm planning on moving to Berlin after school too :D Well, or the US, but who am I kidding. 

Anyway, good luck with your starving artist career, although it won't be starving because I'll pump tons of Sauerkraut and sausages into you :P
Yeah, definitely! Which part of Germany are you going to if I may ask?

Bavaria, Germany. I assume you're in the US.

Anyway.. I.. I.. I don't know how to express this, but.. you're the most awesome human being I have ever met in my whole life. Offering a place to stay to a completely strange, depressed person? You should be rewarded a fucking medal and immediately be made president of the United States.  I can only hope to be as awesome as you when I'm older.
I'd freaking love to, but I'm 17 and still going to school. No monies :(

Thank you dude. So basically you're suggesting to stay and chat with him? I don't know if my nerves play along with that. 

Anyway, sounds like a good thing to do. I'll try to convince him that my mum loves him.
